name: dude-toldya
description: Recalls relevant, origin-tagged correction excerpts within the same working directory, reports model-labelled correction patterns, and guides subagent model selection. Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Recall relevant past corrections in the same workspace
interface.longDescription: Recalls relevant, origin-tagged correction excerpts from the same working directory. Legacy unscoped records are retained but not automatically recalled. Local history reports are model classifications, not verified outcomes. Subagent model-selection guidance checks missing model arguments; cheaper execution is not guaranteed. Storage is local, but selected answer/reply excerpts are processed by your CLI provider and recalled quotes enter the host model context. No publisher telemetry or API key required.
